'''Scratch''' was a particular large [[minstyngar]] that lived in the [[Shadowlands/Legends|Shadowlands]], the dark ground level of the forests of the planet [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].

It was killed in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] by a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] sent by either [[Harwakokok]] the Mighty or [[Krepauk]].

==Behind the scenes==
Scratch first appeared in [[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees|''Rage of the Wookiees'']], the second expansion for [[Sony]] Online Entertainment's [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. In the quest ''The Smiting of Old Scratch'', the Wookiee Harwakokok asks the player to kill Scratch to earn his trust.

The creature appeared again in the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]]'' scenario ''Minstyngar Hunt'' that was available in March and April 2010. In this scenario, the player is asked by the Wookiee Krepauk to kill the creature and bring him Scratch's head.<ref>{{SonyForumsCite|url=strategygames/posts/list.m?topic_id=25361|text=HUNT DOWN SOME GREAT LOOT IN THE STAR WARS GALAXIES™ TRADING CARD GAME MARCH SCENARIO!|nobackup=1}}</ref> It is unknown which version of Scratch's death is the canonical version.
